note: Reviewed private roles of airk. A served role starts only after its authority check; a pending role answers role_not_available until its step lands; a bare or unknown selector answers role_admission_refused. Existing hidden commands keep working until Phase 4.

roles.name: service-detached
roles.started_by: airk with no arguments, or airkctl service start
roles.authority: --runtime-dir <absolute control root> and --start-request <nonce>: an owner-private airk-start-request/1 file at <control>/start/<nonce>.json, at most 30 s old, consumed atomically before any state is opened; explicit mode clears a saved Stop, automatic mode honors it

roles.name: service-foreground
roles.started_by: development, tests and an external supervisor in the foreground (was `airk serve`)
roles.authority: --runtime-dir <absolute control root> [--idle-exit-seconds 1..3600]: the service's own admission, as `serve` had it: the control root is created or verified owner-only for the current user and the single-instance lease refuses a second resident; no installation is read

roles.name: setup-interim
roles.started_by: tests, harnesses and pre-split installer flows until Phase 7 (U93); not a user interface
roles.authority: the remaining arguments are the pre-split airk command line, limited to runtime, setup, uninstall, host, service legacy, the developer dump-vocab and the process-fixture workers; each keeps its own pre-split checks; interim and non-shippable, removed when the Phase 7 setup role owns these operations

roles.name: service-login
roles.started_by: Task Scheduler task, SMAppService agent or systemd user unit
roles.authority: --install-id equal to the install pointer's; own image path and digest equal to the install record's airk; the login receipt names this registration (Phase 7)

roles.name: pdf-child
roles.authority: stdin and stdout are pipes; first frame {schema: airk-pdf-child/1, parent_instance, nonce} within 5 s; opens no file (today the admission-free __airk_pdf_worker selector)

roles.name: record-error
roles.started_by: airkctl service record-error while the service is down (U75)
roles.authority: --runtime-dir <absolute owner-only control root> and --operation <snake-case name>; stdin carries at most 16 KiB of {code, detail}; appends only to the raw job-error ring after its ownership proof, through the service's own writer (split step 3b.2)

roles.name: setup
roles.started_by: the installer wrapper or airkctl service uninstall
roles.authority: --operation <path> passing the airk-setup-operation/1 checks; own signature or pinned digest verified; single use (Phase 7)
